title: change request / Änderungsantrag (AF-610)
author: dev-blueprint (Amendment B build)

create.reason: open an Änderungsantrag; the only path to a new baseline (NG-22); stamps the requesting session
approve + cut new baseline; self-approval allowed & recorded, refused in the request's own session, four-eyes tenant setting
self-approval allowed cross-session & recorded; SAME-SESSION self-approval rejected; four-eyes refuses self-approval; re-approval refused

agent_prompt: The Änderungsantrag is the only path from one baseline to the next (NG-22). DECISION: the same person may be requester AND approver — allowed by default, recorded in the ledger, shown in the Schutzprofil version history as 'beantragt und freigegeben von derselben Person'. It is separated in time: a self-approval may NEVER occur in the same session as the request. Four-eyes (requester and approver must differ) is a per-tenant setting. Approval builds and publishes a new immutable baseline citing the change request as its basis. TDD; the same-session rejection has an explicit test.
